decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to apply aggressive pressure on the opponent using a combination of strong creatures and disruptive spells. The deck utilizes efficient removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with the opponent's threats while Thoughtseize and Duress disrupt their hand. Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester provide efficient early-game creatures that can apply pressure and gain value. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds additional disruption and card advantage to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to quickly and consistently reduce the opponent's life total while disrupting their game plan.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while generating value for the player. The deck achieves this by utilizing various discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's hand, combined with cards like Waste Not to gain additional card advantage. Removal spells such as Go for the Throat and Fatal Push are included to deal with creatures, while the planeswalker Liliana of the Veil provides both disruption and card advantage. The deck also features Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The Meathook Massacre as win conditions, and utilizes lands like Geier Reach Sanitarium to further disrupt the opponent's hand.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize Jeskai Ascendancy and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate a large amount of card advantage and mana acceleration. The deck aims to play a lot of cheap artifacts and spells, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's ability to untap creatures and generate more mana. Emry, Lurker of the Loch can then recur artifacts from the graveyard, allowing for additional triggers and a continuous stream of resources. The deck also includes spell pierce and Tormod's Crypt to disrupt opponents' strategies and control the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive creature plays paired with disruption and removal spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of early-game threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Graveyard Trespasser, backed up by efficient removal like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. Additionally, powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide the deck with late-game threats to ensure victory. With a balanced mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and outpace the opponent.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures and powerful red and white instants. The deck focuses on boosting creature power and protecting them with cards like Homestead Courage, Gods Willing, and Reckless Rage. It also utilizes cards like Tenth District Legionnaire and Dreadhorde Arcanist to maximize the value of instants and sorceries. With a mix of cheap creatures and burn spells, the deck aims to quickly deal damage and control the board, pressuring the opponent into submission.

This deck focuses on building a strong board presence and generating a high devotion to green. It utilizes cards like Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Oath of Nissa to ramp up mana and consistently play big green threats. The key cards in this deck are Karn, the Great Creator, Cavalier of Thorns, and Old-Growth Troll, which provide additional value and disruption. The deck also includes Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Wolfwillow Haven for additional mana ramp and card draw. To further strengthen the board, Storm the Festival is included to search for multiple creatures at once. Finally, there are a few control elements with Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset and Boseiju, Who Endures for protection.

The main strategy of this deck is to utilize sacrifice effects to gain incremental value and control the board while dealing damage to the opponent through cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional flexibility and power to the deck. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of lands that provide mana fixing and utility effects to support the aggressive game plan with a strong sacrifice synergy.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Lotus Field combo to generate massive amounts of mana and play powerful spells. The deck aims to quickly assemble Lotus Field along with cards like Voyaging Satyr and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap it, allowing for repeated use of its mana ability. This enables the deck to cast spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience, which can generate overwhelming advantage or win the game on the spot. Supporting cards like Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages help fuel the combo by digging for crucial pieces or untapping lands.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to stall and control the opponent's board using counterspells and removal spells. It relies on cards like Sinister Sabotage, Negate, Fatal Push, and Sheoldred's Edict to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also focuses on card advantage and deck manipulation with cards like Dig Through Time, Cling to Dust, and Memory Deluge. Additionally, the deck has a win condition in the form of Shark Typhoon, which can generate an army of flying sharks to close out the game.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage provided by Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Strict Proctor and Fateful Absence while also stalling the game with board wipes like Supreme Verdict. Additionally, the deck includes alternative win conditions with creatures like Horned Loch-Whale and The Wandering Emperor. The mana base includes various utility lands to support the deck's control strategy and ensure consistent mana sources.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a high amount of green devotion through cards like Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Oath of Nissa. This allows for powerful creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn to be played efficiently. The deck also utilizes Planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to provide additional value and disruption. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Storm the Festival and Cityscape Leveler to further enhance its aggressive strategy and overwhelm opponents with large threats.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a mix of small, aggressive creatures and combat tricks to protect them. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for flexibility in the mana base while still maintaining a strong aggressive curve. Cards like Reckless Rage and Monstrous Rage help remove blockers and push through damage, while protection spells like Gods Willing ensure key creatures can survive to keep the pressure on. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and close out games before opponents can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, aggressive creatures. By using cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to pump up your creatures, along with protection spells like Brave the Elements, you aim to quickly build a board presence and deal damage efficiently. Cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Ossification help to protect your key creatures, while Castle Ardenvale provides a way to generate additional threats. With a focus on efficient and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board control.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo mechanic of Transmogrify to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield. The deck includes several removal and disruption spells to control the opponent's board while setting up the combo. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional consistency and mana acceleration. The deck focuses on creating a value engine by using Tribute to Horobi and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate extra creatures and card advantage. The deck also includes a mix of versatile and resilient creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Mirrex to further enhance its combo strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. It also utilizes disruptive spells such as Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan. The deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil for additional value. Additionally, it has a few utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Hive of the Eye Tyrant to provide additional advantages. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats while disrupting their strategy.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy by utilizing removal spells like Go for the Throat and Fatal Push, along with hand disruption like Thoughtseize. The deck also aims to control the board using cards like The Meathook Massacre and Graveyard Trespasser. Additionally, the deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Misery's Shadow to close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and grind out incremental advantages until it can secure a victory.
